title: cracca cinerea
intro: Cracca cinerea, commonly known as White Horse Bean, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and diuretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Cracca cinerea include treating conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
